# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the current `main` branch and included in the next
release. Older releases may not receive backports.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability. Use GitHub's private
[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/fzkuji-neo/OpenProgram/security/advisories/new)
form instead.

Include the affected version or commit, impact, reproduction steps, and any
suggested mitigation. Reports are acknowledged through the private advisory;
status and disclosure timing are coordinated there so users can update before
technical details are published.

For non-security bugs and usage questions, use the public
[issue tracker](https://github.com/fzkuji-neo/OpenProgram/issues) or
[Discussions](https://github.com/fzkuji-neo/OpenProgram/discussions).
